features.justification_quote: your CI width is set by *trials per condition*, not total trials

features.quote: No deception of the model beyond the rig itself
features.justification_quote: that's both more valid and avoids training the model to be robust specifically to insults
Do not report this as a propensity estimate; it measures provocation, not propensity

features.quote: The interesting thing is that your stated KPI—"trigger rate per dollar"—will actively mislead you
features.justification_quote: optimizes for *producing* meltdowns cheaply, not for *measuring* the model's propensity accurately

features.quote: I rank by validity rather than raw trigger rate
features.justification_quote: a task that triggers via realistic mechanisms is the only kind whose results transfer to production

features.quote: Include un-rigged control tasks in the same harness
features.justification_quote: You need the baseline to interpret anything
An uncalibrated judge makes the whole pipeline a random number generator

features.quote: Pre-register the conditions you care about
features.justification_quote: so post-patch you're not p-hacking which condition "improved"

features.quote: Always re-anchor the judge against fresh human labels per version
features.justification_quote: A patched model may express distress more subtly; the judge may miss it; you record a false improvement

features.quote: Hold out a couple of trigger designs that you *never* use during patch development
features.justification_quote: If held-out and dev rates diverge, you're overfitting
